title: Kuznetsov components and transcendental motives of cubic fourfolds
summary: Let $X \subset ¶^5_{\C}$ be a smooth cubic fourfold.The Kuznetsov component $\sA_X$ is contained in the derived category $D^b(X)$ and the transcendental motive $t(X)$ is contained in the category of Chow motives $\sM_{rat}(\C))$. If $X$ and $Y$ are {\it Fourier -Mukai partners} and hence the categories $\sA_X$ and $\sA_Y$ are equivalent, then their transcendental motives $t(X)$ and $t(Y)$ are isomorphic.
